description: Digitraffic rail traffic is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Liikenteenohjausyhtiö Fintraffic Oy. The source of open rail data is Fintraffic Raide Oy's operational infrastructure capacity management systems, from which data is extracted to the open data interface. The open data interface is REST-type and contains several data types. Queries can be made to the interface, to which the interface responds with a result set in JSON format. Coverage: Liikenteenohjausyhtiö Fintraffic Oy. The publisher named on the listing is Liikenteenohjausyhtiö Fintraffic Oy. Its keywords include rataliikenne, junaliikenne. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
